description: This file contains shared utilities, type definitions, and functions for managing the state of a 3-step persona onboarding flow in a UI application. It handles local storage interactions, state updates, and placeholder persona generation based on uploaded documents and LinkedIn connection status.

methods.name: safeParse
methods.description: Parses JSON string into PersonaFlowState object safely, returning null if parsing fails.

methods.name: getDefaultState
methods.description: Returns the default state for the persona flow.
